program: VALORIA PRODUCTION ART SYSTEM RESET v1
hard_reject: reads as rock mass rather than reusable architecture for the intended role
single-purpose silhouette that cannot be re-authored without obvious collage
material/UV layout makes modular reuse destructive
official-camera readability is worse than current accepted composition
requires paid generation to become usable

score_dimensions.description: real recesses, roof thickness, structural layers, trim and silhouette
can approach Hero Bastion richness without looking like a different game
can be cut/recombined/cleaned in Blender into a reusable family
existing basecolor/RM/normal contain useful production detail
macro form remains legible at zoom9/mobile
supports the intended role without relying on labels

decision_rules: Do not select by triangle count alone.
Whole-asset reuse is allowed only as a temporary donor proof; final family source must be saved as authored Blender source.
Hero Bastion is a quality reference, not a donor to clone wholesale.
StoneArchitecture/TowerWallRock may donate defensive grammar; MidTier may donate residential/civic grammar.
Aserradero/Cuartel/Granero may donate surface/silhouette ideas but their thousands of loose fragments make automatic semantic extraction unsuitable.
c4_output: One coherent Blender-authored starter family using selected donor grammar, not a collage of unrelated whole GLBs.
